title: CAREER EXPERIENCE DRIVE INTERN
desc:
Gensenta
As one of Türkiye's leading, oldest and most established pharmaceutical companies, Gensenta has been serving public health for nearly a century. With its renewed identity since 2020, the company continues to expand into broader geographies, reach more patients and deliver new, comprehensive solutions, while improving patients' access to medicines.
Gensenta also exports from Türkiye to regions that make up 70% of the global pharmaceutical market. Since November 2022, we have operated as a member of the Eczacıbaşı Group.
As part of our KDS Program, we are looking for long-term interns to join our
Procurement
,
Supply Planning
,
Sustainability
,
R&D
and
Engineering
teams.
What Do We Expect from Our New Team Member?
Support the team's daily operational and technical processes
Contribute to data collection, analysis, reporting and documentation activities
Track processes and action items to ensure timely completion of tasks
Take part in preparing presentations, analyses and evaluation reports
Support the team in coordination efforts with other functions
Help simplify routine reports and automate them with digital tools where appropriate
Develop innovative ideas and actionable recommendations for process improvement, efficiency and digitalization initiatives
Carry out analysis, deliverable preparation and presentation work within assigned projects and/or business processes
What kind of teammate are we looking for?
Senior undergraduate students or master's thesis students in Industrial, Chemical, Environmental, Mechanical or Electrical-Electronics Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Business Administration, Economics or related fields
Available to work at least 3 weekdays per week
Proficient in MS Office applications, especially Excel
Good written and verbal command of English
Strong analytical thinking, research, reporting and problem-solving skills
Strong planning, organization and follow-up skills
Interested in data analytics, digitalization and AI-enabled ways of working
A team player with strong communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with diverse teams
Responsible, open to new ideas and eager to learn
What do we offer you?
At Eczacıbaşı, you can steadily improve your personal, professional, and technical competencies by participating in
training programs
that support you and your career.
You will have access to opportunities for
rotation
among more than 50 companies and
global experience
in over 120 international markets.
Vacation time
at Eczacıbaşı is calculated according to seniority based on your total work experience. Your bring your seniority with you.
We will always recognize your success through different
reward
methods.
You can take advantage of location-independent or hybrid work opportunities through
different work models
suitable to the nature of your job, and you can determine your own work schedule with
flexible work hours
. We offer technology and ergonomic support packages to Eczacıbaşı employees who work remotely full-time.
As a new parent working at Eczacıbaşı, you are privileged. Eczacıbaşı employees who are mothers are provided with monthly
nursery support;
Eczacıbaşı employees who are fathers are entitled to a 3-week paternity leave.
People who savor
culture and art
are here! Thanks to the Eczacıbaşı Group’s founding sponsorship of
Istanbul Modern
, Turkey's first modern and contemporary art museum, you can visit the museum for free. Additionally, thanks to Eczacıbaşı Group’s founding sponsorship of
Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts
(İKSV), you can also enjoy the privilege and discounts of İKSV’s
Lale Card
to all İKSV events.
You can participate in Eczacıbaşı’s
volunteering activities
, every one of which prioritizes social benefit, and get involved in projects that create social impact.
We are committed to ensuring
equal opportunity
of employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or seniority.
